page: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is a graphics-intensive virtual server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores) running at 2.4 GHz, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache. The system includes 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering 96 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 1900 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in single-core tasks, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores placing in the top 10%. Large language model (LLM) inference speeds are highly competitive, with prompt processing and text generation for 135M and 7B parameter models ranking in the top 10%, and 70B model prompt processing in the top 25%. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks also show strong performance.

Given the high-density allocation of 96 GB VRAM relative to 8 vCPUs, this server offers a specialized hardware profile that is highly resource-efficient for GPU-bound workloads without requiring excessive CPU overhead. It is suited for graphics-intensive applications, LLM inference, machine learning workloads, and data processing tasks requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
